def square(n: Int): Int = n * n

println(square(5))

sealed trait Expr
case class Num(n: Int) extends Expr
case class Add(l: Expr, r: Expr) extends Expr

def eval(e: Expr): Int = e match {
  case Num(n) => n
  case Add(l, r) => eval(l) + eval(r)
}
